**Finding: Deviation (critical) — Article III Ownership**

The ownership architecture runs entirely one way:

- **p0048 (Article III)** vests all right, title and interest in the Licensed Technology and "all Intellectual Property Rights therein" in Licensor.
- **p0005** defines "Derivative Work" broadly (any additions, modifications, improvements or enhancements based on the Licensed Technology), which captures the bespoke **unique client front end and enhancements we commission and pay for under Article VII(b) (p0087)**.
- **p0043** reserves all rights not expressly granted to Licensor, so we get only the restricted non-exclusive Field-of-Use licence — no ownership and no perpetual licence back to work we fund.
- The Agreement is **silent on our data**: "Intellectual Property Rights" is defined as Licensor's rights only (p0008) and Confidential Information is one-way (p0004), leaving our trading, order and client data unprotected by any ownership statement.

**Redline (validated, ok:true)** — a single inserted paragraph after p0048 that: (i) assigns customer-funded Custom Deliverables to us with a perpetual, irrevocable, royalty-free licence back for Licensor's embedded pre-existing IP; (ii) confirms we retain all rights in Licensee Data and that nothing assigns our IP or data to Licensor; and (iii) bars joint ownership. Licensor's ownership of its platform is left untouched, and the fallback (perpetual licence instead of assignment) is offered in the comment.
